description: The modal adapter (separate :5001 process): extraction stages over a measurement folder, and applying the result to the running preset (:5000).

commands.name: modal.run_stage
commands.title: Run a modal extraction stage
commands.description: Runs one extraction stage on the modal adapter (:5001): pipeline (load, mapping, ESPRIT, tracking, feedin), esprit, tracking or feedin. The remaining args are the stage's own body (see the stage endpoint). Long-running: returns a jobId; progress comes from /modal/status.

commands.name: modal.status
commands.title: Modal extraction status
commands.description: Progress of the running extraction (state idle|running|done|error, progress, message).

commands.name: modal.cancel
commands.title: Cancel the modal extraction
commands.description: Cancels the current modal adapter operation.

commands.name: modal.apply_to_preset
commands.title: Apply modal results to the preset
commands.description: Applies the selected extracted modes (frequencies, damping, feedin / feedback) to the running synthesis preset on :5000. Rewrites whole preset sections.
